given: the home-screen stock table is displaying one or more rows
then: the quantity values are right-aligned in their column so they read as a scannable numeric list

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the rows and their SKU/location/quantity content exist; AC2 asserts a distinct presentation outcome — the quantity column's right-alignment — which can break independently while the rows still render correctly.

architectural_notes: E2E: right-alignment is a presentation outcome on the same flat server-populated table. The boundary returns JSON only (R5); presentation lives in the React client component, never in the boundary or a template. Verified through the SPA rendering real server rows against the live API — the quantity column reads as a scannable right-aligned numeric list. No backend/domain logic.
